<thought>Using the formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the given molecular formula C5H16O4 (no N or halogens), we calculate DBE = (2*5 + 2 - 16)/2 = (10 + 2 - 16)/2 = -4/2 = -2, which is not physically possible; the compound is fully saturated, so the DBE is effectively 0.</thought>
<final_answer>0</final_answer>
